joined_to_the_capability_cliff: G012_CAPABILITY_CLIFF measured the lowest capability-PASSING point in the entire campaign at 3.2831 complete EBPW. Reaching 1.5 requires a param-weighted mean of 1.5 bpw across all 26.9B parameters. So the target is not 2.2x away in one organ -- it is 2.2x away in the ORGANISM, and every candidate that has entered that region has failed the conjunction.
what_this_licenses: search must change class, not tighten. No allocation of Q4-and-above rates between these two organs reaches either gate, so the levers that remain are the ones that stop preserving the parent topology: generated organs, procedural representation, functional substitution, shared nonlinear structure, exact islands with generated remainder.
what_this_does_not_say: that the gates are wrong -- the directive states them as objectives. That any particular sub-Q4 representation preserves capability; this is byte arithmetic and the conjunction gate is separate and, per the cliff, unforgiving. That the resident is the only candidate.
scar: COMPUTE THE FLOOR BEFORE SEARCHING THE SPACE. A negative required rate is an impossibility proof and it costs one division.
